design.decision: Save a trump or a top card for trick 13, even when cashing it earlier would be easier.
design.opponent: Shown on the last trick. Opponents can hoard their own last winners.
design.rationale: This is a points version of the strong seed-last-trick line, a different category. Saving a winner works against overtricks, so it suits Exact.
design.draftText: +40 contract points when your team wins the last trick of a round

critic.concerns: Same signature as cc-win-last-points, differing only in amount; merge them. The Exact tag is weak.

history.note: draft-common: also proposed as cc-win-last-points with a different amount.
draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-last-pts); credited to both sources.
